technical.summary: AKAM shows long-term bullish structure with price above key moving averages and positive reversal patterns, but lacks trend confirmation (low ADX), momentum acceleration, and money flow support; overbought conditions and weak short-term structure present pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 14 days create a low-conviction setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: Weak congressional selling pressure from junior members combined with elevated market fear (38/100) presents a mild contrarian buy setup, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional activity (265+ days) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (317.44) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 14 days adds binary event risk; macro score of -1 confirms hostile environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with three white soldiers and supertrend bullish reversal pattern offers long-term structural support in a fear-driven market where contrarian positioning could reward early buyers.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (317.44), high earnings risk in 14 days, overbought technicals (StochRSI, Williams %R), weak momentum (negative AO, no ADX confirmation), and zero fundamental/smart money support create a hostile risk/reward setup that demands patience.

decision.entry_rationale: AKAM shows long-term bullish structure (price above 200-EMA, three white soldiers) and contrarian opportunity in fear-driven market, but conviction is severely undermined by extreme macro hostility and earnings binary event.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis (317.44) combined with earnings announcement in 14 days creates uncontrollable binary event risk that negates technical setup quality.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
